title: The Installment Concerned by a TRICARE Prime Duplicate Payment Refund
content:
**Points of judgement for the billing desk.** When an installment other than the first installment of a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment has been paid more than once, the installment the duplicate refund concerns is fixed from the payments on the enrollment's fee account.

1. Where a payment made through a method other than the enrollment's payment arrangement stands on the account, the duplicate refund concerns the installment against which the largest such payment stands.
2. Where none does but the largest single payment on the account exceeds the charge of the installment it was posted against, it concerns that installment.
3. Otherwise it concerns the installment against which the payment posted most recently stands.

Of equally large payments the one posted latest is taken.

## Input - judgement - installment (hypothetical account, arrangement: electronic funds transfer, monthly installments of 32.51)

| Payments on the account | Judgement | Installment concerned |
|---|---|---|
| 32.51 by transfer against January, 32.51 by transfer against February, 50.00 by check against February | a check payment stands; the largest such is 50.00 | February |
| 32.51 by transfer against January, 65.02 by transfer against March, 32.51 by transfer against April | no other-method payment; the largest single payment, 65.02, exceeds March's 32.51 charge | March |
| 32.51 by transfer against each of January to April, the April one posted last | no other-method payment; no payment exceeds its charge | April |
